mobile: Safari 26.4 iOS Simulator iPhone 17 Pro, viewport 402x714
scope: Experiential review, salon owner arriving from Zalo; all 19 mobile pages, offer, pricing, examples, registration destination. No product edits.
limitations: Not launched inside Zalo in-app browser
Controls traversed using WebDriver and DOM activation; no conclusive full pinch/swipe validation
No physical device or network performance measurement
Desktop examined in WebKit, not macOS Safari
main_finding: Mobile hides the scene behind a full-screen glass panel and replaces desktop product evidence with copy; preserve cinematic scene and choreograph visible product outcomes.

priorities.finding: Pages 3 and 6 hide all product content during 2.6-second room walk, then replace scene with full-screen glass.
priorities.change: Keep a readable portrait scene, introduce a brief caption late in the walk, then reveal the product at camera stop. Use glass locally.

priorities.finding: Desktop after-state shows calendar, reservation and reminder; mobile after-state is mainly prose, hypothetical numbers and a toast.
priorities.change: Show the same reservation arriving in the calendar and its reminder; subordinate metrics.

priorities.finding: Headline, numeral, description, old problem, caption and callout compete with screenshot.
priorities.change: One benefit headline, one large product crop, one callout; remove repeated old-problem copy.

priorities.finding: 9 of 19 pages are Zalo/AI steps; calculator interrupts product demo.
priorities.change: Move calculator to price, reduce AI to 2 examples, connect Zalo booking to visible calendar early. Preserve salon journey.

priorities.finding: Hero headline communicates mood before product; mobile omits free-year/no-card microcopy.
priorities.change: Add concrete appointments/customers/Zalo value and Basic first-year/no-card line. Distinguish View demo from Start free.

priorities.finding: Ultra recommendation promises multi-location capabilities that plan copy labels coming soon.
priorities.change: Show coming-soon status in recommendation itself. Label illustrative benefits next to numbers, narrow migration promise to service import.

priorities.finding: Invisible next/back regions coexist with screenshot zoom, sliders and chat controls. Last AI step lacks prominent offer transition.
priorities.change: Visible small previous/next controls plus final free-plan CTA; keep horizontal gestures and free vertical scroll.

priorities.finding: Pricing CTA is strong; fictional salon cases have long setup before product results.
priorities.change: Keep pricing CTA and explicit renewal price; shorten each case to problem, product result, 3 benefits; collapse calculation assumptions.

preserve: Real mobile CRM crops and zoom
cta_result: Start free navigated to /vi/business/join; email-only form rendered.
